comments: HST/WFPC2 used 17 F555W and 4 F814W epochs. Although 95 bona fide Cepheids were catalogued, the adopted modulus uses 45 with logP>1.25, 0.60<(V-I)<1.10 and Q>=4. A +0.05 mag long/short-exposure correction was applied. No metallicity correction; aperture and zero-point systematics were discussed but not separately quantified.

Alternative Key Project fit to the original Saha et al. photometry, using the article's stated 44-Cepheid P>18 d sample. This shorter cutoff is more susceptible to incompleteness than the preferred P>25 d fit.

Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL solution from 51 of 94 Cepheids with P>25 d, selected to reduce incompleteness bias. It agrees with the earlier Saha et al. distance; no metallicity correction enters the tabulated modulus.
There are no specific comments on the publication. Cepheid moduli are compiled and homogenized from earlier HST Key Project and independent studies. Previous author included it.

WFC-only true modulus from 45 Cepheids. The PC-WFC difference is +0.031+/-0.113 mag, consistent with zero and smaller than the +0.11 mag severe-blending prediction. No metallicity correction was applied.

PC-only true modulus from six Cepheids, calculated as part of the blending test. It is not the paper's adopted global distance to NGC 4496A. The quoted uncertainty is internal and no systematic term is tabulated.

Uncorrected re-fit of 51 previously selected Cepheids using the Stetson WFPC2 zero point and Udalski OGLE-LMC PL relations. The listed uncertainty is the internal R_PL term; systematic components are discussed but not assigned individually.
The largest sample among these hosts gives a small random error. Sandage/Saha HST data reanalyzed by the Key Project are fitted with OGLE-LMC slopes. LMC zero-point systematics are excluded.
Final period-cut Wesenheit fit before abundance correction. e_R is the random PL-fit error only; N_cef is the post-cut sample.
Not flagged as a preferred near-solar solution. Despite the small internal error, lowering Vlim by 0.5 mag shifts mu by +0.42 mag. The 280 sosie matches are not distinct Cepheids.
HIPPARCOS-calibrated PL result with a small internal error and weak sensitivity to the limiting-magnitude test.
Representative mean-light OGLE LMC solution. Includes the +0.05 mag STS CTE correction but no metallicity correction.
Maximum-light LMC PL solution. CTE corrected and consistent with the corresponding mean-light result.
Representative FSG03 Galactic mean-light solution. Includes the STS CTE correction; no metallicity adjustment.
